title: Evening Oct 30: defensive, two breakout shorts on
journal: Book ~$541 (0.99x). Regime defensive (SOL $95 vs. 20-day average $104, BTC ~$76.8K, 2 of 19 large memes above their average). The radar's news-shock SOL short closed on its 6-hour time limit at roughly break-even (−$0.06); minutes later SOL touched its 55-day low and the 55/20 breakout system opened its own SOL short ($14 collateral, 2x, exit at the 20-day high $113.39). The ETH short from the same system is still open. Both are copied in every user wallet (checked tonight). The Binance hack story keeps producing headlines (FBI, Secret Service, CFTC) but price is not confirming (SOL +0.8% in 4h), so the radar is correctly not opening a new short. No memecoins: none with a verifiable story passes the filters. Devil's advocate: a relief bounce can squeeze both shorts; each risks about 1% of the book and exits automatically.
